question: Under a fixed two-user distortion-repayment contract, what can be certified, ruled out, or left unresolved before future viewports are known, and which ideal completion decisions survive measured software playback?

contract.reserve: sum of two rung-2 file sizes over the four original recovery parents
contract.extra_bytes: sum of positive pair-byte excess over the matched rung-2 pair; no refunds or refills
contract.quality: duration-weighted native viewport MSE improvement; original 12x6 tile-centre 100x100-degree angular window with cosine-latitude weights
contract.credit: positive parent improvement credited only when the complete recipient parent finishes by the deadline
contract.floors: both users at least their rung-2 native quality on every selected recovery parent, including parents completing late
contract.future_mask_class: all 216 masks of the unchanged sampled angular-window model, independently at each quality sample
contract.policy_class: deterministic causal whole-parent choices committed before playback of that parent
contract.clock: elapsed from first recovery request; no free buffer, waiting, prefetch or restored budget

sampling.primary_unit: source clip; paired identity episodes nested within clip
sampling.source_choice: external primary-source benchmark pending access and alignment verification; no automatic fallback
sampling.clip_selection: all original test clips in the frozen chosen benchmark meeting metadata-only duration and alignment rules; never choose by quality or recovery
sampling.window: first 60 seconds of the original experiment's presentation interval, respecting its published source-video offset; no concatenation, repetition or time stretching
sampling.trace_eligibility: at least two source identities with original trace timestamps bracketing all required samples; next-sample age at most 0.1 seconds; no outcome-based filtering
sampling.pairing: lexicographically sorted eligible source IDs in one directed cycle; each ID once as recipient and once as donor per clip
sampling.no_event: zero past loss is not a recovery success; report separately
sampling.reference_infeasible: a rung-2 pair violating the original cap is a separately reported service-feasibility outcome, not a reason to retune or quietly drop the clip
sampling.missing_data: retain every registered clip and pair with its missing, invalid, timeout or excluded reason
sampling.independence: new source collection does not establish population sampling or verified cross-dataset identity disjointness
sampling.analysis: clip-wise counts and equal-clip macro summaries, with pooled episode counts secondary; no p-values or iid binomial intervals over pairs, frames or reruns

media_pipeline.encode: 1920x960, 30 fps, H.264 NVENC p5/hq VBR, 60-frame GOP; existing rounded-kbps/maxrate/bufsize rules unchanged
media_pipeline.analysis: 960x480 grayscale at 1 Hz; original half-second sample convention and micro-MSE/duration arithmetic
media_pipeline.reference: the verified original experiment stimulus, not an assumed lossless original or a substituted online upload
media_pipeline.no_tuning: no content-dependent ladder, floor, FOV, target, viewport predictor or budget selection
media_pipeline.source_adapter: coordinate, projection and source-offset mapping must be independently checked and frozen before new pose-derived labels or recovery outcomes

comparisons: all-tile convex envelopes versus exact geometric-mask envelopes under identical resources and clocks
exact future-known finite-path oracle as evaluation only
action-conditioned upper bound for unrestricted deterministic causal whole-parent policies
frozen past-only point forecast and cost-greedy, rolling Nash and max-min paths; report identical controls as equivalent, not independent corroboration
reject-all and abstain-all diagnostic decisions, without treating either as a useful certified admission service
primary_endpoints: soundness violations, including any certified lower bound above the exact observed-trace oracle or optimistic rejection of a trace-feasible case
additional certified optimistic rejections from geometric versus convex envelopes, by clip
recorded-trace feasible episodes whose unrestricted universal promise is ruled out by the conditional policy upper bound
admit, impossible and abstain counts, with fulfilled-admission fraction undefined when there are no admissions
lower and upper bound gaps normalized by positive initial debt, alongside absolute native units

timing_confirmation.selection: first directed pair from the frozen per-clip ID cycle; never the best or nearest-deadline pair
timing_confirmation.order: cyclically rotate the 12 path/unit/startup cells by sorted clip index plus repetition index; sequential execution
timing_confirmation.controls: after each repetition, run both original late-recipient and shared 6MB-background controls on the first sorted clip, cost-greedy, 2-second cold
timing_confirmation.primary_account: unchanged parent debt, floors and complete-parent credit
timing_confirmation.secondary_account: actual derived chunk MSE and chunk floors, separately labeled; no extension of the whole-parent policy theorem
timing_confirmation.scope: headless compositor/software events under controlled loopback service; not HMD pixels, a physical network or subjective QoE

decision_rules.technical_gate: any soundness, conservation, source-alignment or independent-accounting failure invalidates the affected claim; quarantine and version an amendment, preserving all attempts
decision_rules.geometric_usefulness: report whether any additional certified rejection occurs externally; zero means no external decision-level improvement, even if intervals are numerically tighter
decision_rules.information_gap: report whether any observed-trace feasible case also has a universal-policy upper below target; zero leaves the exposed empirical coexistence unconfirmed
decision_rules.timing: report all signed discrepancies and zero discrepancies; do not require or search for a deadline cliff
decision_rules.admission: zero admissions does not establish useful positive admission, safety rate, or controller superiority
decision_rules.not_a_power_calculation: this is a census of a fixed external catalogue, not a powered random-population superiority test
